senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חלב, חלם) [to be smooth, glistening, sharp-edged,]

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="H01001"><he>חלוף</he></cite>, <cite ref="Proverbs 31:8">Prov. XXXI, 8</cite>) <he>שח׳ והלך וכ׳</he> of him who passed away and went &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:5">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> top <he>נַחֲלוֹף את וכ׳</he> let us change our meeting-place.
Dem. III, 5 חשודה לַחֲלוֹף (Y. ed. לחַלֵּף, Pi.) suspected of exchanging (the provision in her trust). Ib. 6 לח׳ את המתקלקל to replace what has been spoiled; a. fr.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 148:9">Yalk. Gen. 148</cite> <he>מי מְחַלְּפוֹ</he> who will replace him? (v. <cite ref="H01058"><he>חֲלִיפִין</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 3:5">Dem. III, 5</cite>, v. supra; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:4">B. Mets. VIII, 4</cite> <he>המַחֲלִיף פרה ב־</he> if one exchanges a cow for an ass.—Dem. l. c. <he>חשודה להַחֲלִיף</he>, v. supra; <cite ref="Chullin 6b:1">Ḥull. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>חשודה מַחֲלֶפֶת</he>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to drive young shoots, to grow again.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 100b">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite>; a. e., v. <cite ref="C00571"><he>גֶּזַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מַחֲלִיף וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00537"><he>גָּזַז</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 9a:8">Erub. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יַחֲלִיפוּ</he> provided they do not change carriers.
<cite ref="Shabbat 8b">Sabb. 8ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 99a:14">Erub. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם לא תַחֲלִיף</he> it is not necessary to reverse (the authorities; <cite ref="Beitzah 3b">Bets. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>תיפוך</he>, v. <cite ref="A02728"><he>אֲפַךְ</he></cite>).—Part. pass. <he>מוּחֲלָף</he>, f. <he>מוּחֲלֶפֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 3b">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ השיטה</he> the statement must be reversed (the authorities for the two opinions must be exchanged); <cite ref="Beitzah 3a">Bets. 3ᵃ</cite>
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 92a">Snh. 92ᵃ</cite>; a. e. <he>כל המחליף וכ׳</he> he who equivocates in his speech, is like an idolater.

senses.gloss: to be exchanged, mixed up. Y. Pes. VI, 33ᶜ bot. דבר שאין דרכו (לֵחָלֵף) לִיתְחַלֵּף a thing which is not likely to be exchanged (by mistake); ib. להִתְחַלֵּיף; ib.ᵈ top.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17b:8">Ab. Zar. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>מעות … נִתְחַלְּפוּ לי וכ׳</he> money set aside for Purim was mixed up with money &c.
Nidd. 52ᵃ ונִתְחַלְּפָה לך וכ׳ and thou madest a mistake between Iyob and oyeb; B. Bath. 16ᵃ ונתחלף.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 16a">Ib.</cite> <he>לא נ׳ לי</he> I make no mistake; a. e.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 29:1">Pesik. R. s. 29</cite> (—30—30) <he>נִתְחַלַּפְתֶּם מן הרעב</he> you have changed (beyond recognition) through starvation; <he>יש לכם להִתְחַלֵּף וכ׳</he> you will change through plenty.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:4">Yalk. Gen. 133</cite> <he>מאיזה שם אני מִתְחַלֵּף</he> (prob. <he>לאיזה</he>) what name I may be ordered to assume in turn.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>, end <he>נתח׳ המלך</he> the king has been succeeded (displaced; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, beg. <he>מת וכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 813:1">Yalk. Deut. 813</cite> <he>כיון שנ׳ וכ׳</he> when the governor was recalled and another &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5">Num. R. s. 5</cite>, beg. <he>להִתְחַלֵּף מעבודה וכ׳</he> to be transferred from one service to another. Y. Taan. II, beg. 65ᵃ <he>היו מִתְחַלְּפִין עליה</he> took turns in guarding it.
